unresolved.reason: Saudi Arabia's expressly closed eVisa list excludes Israel, so no eVisa policy is possible. Its live country-group API also has no Israel record, but neither source establishes an exhaustive Saudi arrival-visa, consular-visa, recognition or refusal rule. Israel's current MFA table says a national Israeli passport needs a visa, without identifying Saudi issuance timing; separately, Israel's National Security Council says an Israeli citizen's visit to Saudi Arabia is prohibited and criminal. That outbound prohibition does not prove the Saudi destination-admission category, so neither visa_on_arrival nor entry_restricted can be safely normalized for this pair.
